phase2.title: Rod filigran-la
phase2.explanation: Avan ou get okenn lot detay dan foto-la, get kwin yo: buku zouti IA azout enn filigran diskre. Gemini, par exanp, souvan met so filigran dan kwin anba adrwat. Bann zouti kouma SynthID osi met bann mark ki lizie touni pa kapav trouve, me ki bann bon zouti kapav detekte.

phase2.title: Depi kont ledwa ziska lir lame difisil
phase2.explanation: Avan, kont ledwa ti ase, me bann modèl IA azordi fer bon lame dan pozision normal. Aster get bann intéraksion konplike: ledwa antrelase, lame ki tini enn ti obze, ouswa lame parsyèlman kouver ar seve ouswa lenz. Get lame tifi ki pe tini sandwich-la: sandwich-la paret pe flote olie ki byen tini, enn sign ki IA-la pa finn byen konpran kontak ant lame ek obze-la.

phase2.title: Text dan fon-la toultan fer trap li
phase2.explanation: Lapo parfe ouswa brians senmetrik dan lizie pa fer trap enn foto IA ankor. Seki ankor rat se text dan fon-la: pankart, ansenn, ouswa do liv, ki dan premie regar paret normal, me kan ou get de pre lelet yo defigire ouswa napa okenn sans.

phase2.title: Bann motif ki kase
phase2.explanation: Brik, karo, tisi, ouswa baraz bizin repete avek enn regilarite matematik. Dan foto fer par IA, motif-la souvan perdi sa regilarite-la, ouswa mem montre enn kouti vizib omilie foto-la, kot desin-la sanze brit.

phase2.title: Lonbraz ek reflet ki pa korespone
phase2.explanation: Verifie si lonbraz-la pwente ver sours limier ki vizib dan foto-la, ek si reflet dan vit, dilo, ouswa metal montre mem sen ki enn vre reflet ti pou montre. Bann inkoherans dan fizik limier-la reste enn parmi bann sign ki pli fiab.

phase2.title: Elema fon ki repete
phase2.explanation: Dan sen ar lafoul ouswa fon detaye, rod figir ouswa dimoun ki repete prèske parey, ouswa detay ki duplike enn fason ki pa natirel. Modèl IA gen tandans klonn elema fon-la olie kree variasyon inik pou sakenn.

phase2.title: Sa kouler tro parfe-la
phase2.explanation: Buku modèl IA gen enn stil par default ki rekonesab: kouler pli satire ki normal, kontras for, ek enn finiti prèske plastik, kouma si tou kitsoz ti pe gagne tro lalimier. Si enn foto paret "tro zoli" ouswa gen enn palet tro inifom pou vre, sa osi enn bon lensiy parey ar nenport ki detay presi.

phase2.title: Ou anvi aprann plis?
phase2.explanation: Nanye ladan pa parfe ouswa san fay: modèl yo pe kontinie amelyore ek sa bann sign-la kapav aret marse nenport ki moman. Alafen, ou bizin servi ou bonsans ek remark si seki ou trouve paret koeran, ouswa si enn kitsoz zis pa korespone. Si ou anvi al pli fon, isi kèk resours pou reste ziska zour lor bann dernie sign pou detekte foto fer par IA (an angle): How to Spot an AI-Generated Image in 2026 (https://www.opticflux.com/how-to-spot-an-ai-generated-image-in-2026-the-tells-that-still-work/79504/), How to Spot AI-Generated Images in 2026: Artifacts, C2PA & SynthID (https://www.eyesift.com/blog/how-to-spot-ai-images-2026/), 9 Common AI Image Artifacts: Spot & Fix (https://zsky.ai/blog/ai-image-artifacts-guide), ek How to Tell if an Image Is AI-Generated in 2026 (https://endertech.com/blog/6-ways-to-identify-ai-generated-images-with-examples).
